register.name: Sustainable notes, three-year (2026)
register.detail: Govern d’Andorra · announced 30 September 2026 · three-year term · coupon 3.87% · under the €1.2 billion programme of 23 September 2026
register.note: Demand of €1,292 million, 2.58 times the amount issued, from 57 investors in 16 countries
register.text: Sustainable notes of the Principality of Andorra, issued under Andorra’s sustainable financing framework to investors that include the European Commission and the European Investment Bank. They refinance in advance the €500 million of notes issued in 2022, which mature in February 2027, at a spread of 32 basis points against 71 in 2022, and fund the public budget that carries the seven standards.

register.text: A framework loan for renewable electricity generation, transmission and distribution networks, and district heating and cooling in Andorra, with projects developed mainly by Forces Elèctriques d’Andorra (FEDA). It widens the pool of international finance for the Principality and serves the energy standard.
